name: word_grounding
provenance: No git (user decision 2026-11-14). Each run stores a code/config/queries snapshot + sha256 in results/<run>/_snapshot and MANIFEST per condition.

splits.source: data/pilot P01-P10 (Cheese JPEG, 2026-11-14). User decision: only small pallets + blocks change, robot excluded.
splits.rule: chronological, fixed before any model was run on these images

camera.fourcc_note: YUYV = uncompressed from the sensor (MJPG is JPEG-compressed). Camera exposes no exposure control; auto white balance is ON and is recorded, not changed.

image_space: raw (distorted) camera pixels, 1920x1080, x right, y down, origin top-left. Undistortion is NOT applied in this experiment; geometry converts selected points later.

qwen.max_new_tokens_note: 2026-11-15 (run02~): C1 512->1024 (dev run01: 21/30 invalid hit the cap), C6 128->256 (run01 C6-pf: 49/49 invalid hit the cap; C6-dino top15 never reached 128). Applied identically to dev and test.
qwen.instruction_language: English for every query; only the query string changes language
qwen.c1_prompt: Find every instance of "{q}" in this image. Return JSON only, no prose: {{"objects": [{{"bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2]}}]}} with integer coordinates normalized to 0-1000 relative to image width and height. If there is no such object, return {{"objects": []}}.
qwen.c6_prompt: Numbered candidate boxes are drawn on this image. Which numbered boxes contain "{q}"? Select every box that contains it and no other box. Return JSON only, no prose: {{"ids": [<numbers>]}}. If no box contains it, return {{"ids": []}}.

c6.dino_filter_grid_note: 2026-11-15 dev grid A (decided before running): dino (0.10/15, run01 setting) vs dino_s10k30, dino_s05k30, dino_s05k60. Candidate-coverage upper bounds on dev en (run01 dev_diag): 0.577 / 0.685 / 0.776 / 0.849. Final success must be re-measured.
c6.note: Candidate filters are initial values; tuned on dev only (DESIGN §9). Detectors only ever receive the query string (q-variants) or nothing (pf).
